items.title: Roost checks its own code
items.text: Admin → Security has a new Check Roost's code button. It reads Roost's files for the mistakes hackers use most (pages loading outside scripts, links built from a visitor's address, new open doors) and lists anything it finds. The same check blocks risky changes before they are merged. Sign-in also now takes the same time for a wrong name as a wrong password.
